title: add vpc control plane provisioning: subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, peering, and route53 dns
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: enable fully-automated provisioning of the Private Control Plane networking surface for VPC-based customer installs. This PR adds Terraform modules, Helm chart values, and installer hooks to create private subnets, configure VPC interface endpoints (S3, ECR, STS), provision security groups for control-plane nodes, establish cross-account VPC peering where required, and automate Route53 delegation/peering DNS setup.

What changed (high-level):
- New terraform modules: vpc-controlplane/subnets, vpc-controlplane/interface_endpoints, vpc-controlplane/peering, vpc-controlplane/route53-delegation. Modules are parameterized for multi-AZ, account ids, and CIDR templates.
- Installer integration: the private-installer now calls the Terraform modules during `provision` step and captures outputs into Helm values for control-plane components.
- Helm chart updates: values.schema.json and control-plane/templates/networking.yaml accept the new subnet and endpoint inputs; added post-upgrade hooks to validate peering and DNS records.
- RBAC / security: reference security-group templates that restrict control-plane egress and management ports by default.
- Tests & docs: added unit tests for the terraform module inputs, and a runbook in docs/installer/private-vpc.md describing upgrade/rollback considerations.

Checklist (performed in this PR):
- [x] Terraform plan and apply tested in staging account (staging-net-2).
- [x] Helm lint + chart unit tests passed locally and on CI.
- [x] End-to-end private-installer flow exercised in a multi-AZ dev environment.
- [x] Runbook added and reviewed by SRE.

Backward compatibility and upgrade notes:
- Existing installs that do not opt into the new terraform modules are unaffected (values default to no-op).
- Upgrades that enable automated peering or route53 delegation will require appropriate IAM permissions; the runbook outlines a manual fallback for customers who prefer to provision peering/DNS outside the installer.
- Post-upgrade hook validates peering connectivity and will mark the release as failed (and trigger rollback) if validation fails.

Related Linear/Jira: ENG-3245 (control-plane vpc automation), INFRA-987 (route53 delegation model).
